# EXITS RE-PRICED ON THE FULL ARMORED BOOK (3/asset/day + first-wall stop).

# TRAIL_giveX% banks max(close, peak*(1-X)) -- an UPPER BOUND on a trailing rule, because it assumes the trail is never hit early and never gives back more than X of the FINAL peak. It is a bound, not a policy.
# EXIT_ORACLE banks max(close, peak) and is CLAIRVOYANT -- the ceiling of all exit work on this book.
# capture_of_entry_ceiling uses the ENTRY foresight denominator, so >1.0 means exit work would carry the book past what entry selection alone could ever reach.
